avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces lorlatinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult oncologist before initiation or discontinuation

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases lorlatinib exposure
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative antimicrobial if possible or monitor drug levels

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase lorlatinib levels and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; advise patient to eliminate from regimen

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibitor; minimal clinical significance at standard doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; use cautiously and report any changes

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation at high doses; limited clinical data with lorlatinib
caution_supplements.action: Use standard dietary doses only; avoid high-dose supplements

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases lorlatinib plasma concentration and systemic exposure
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; use alternative citrus fruits (oranges, lemons)

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase lorlatinib absorption; food effects are moderate
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal patterns; take with or without food consistently as directed

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (Broccoli, Cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains compounds that may weakly induce CYP3A4 at very high intake
caution_foods.action: No dietary restriction needed at normal consumption; maintain balanced diet

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of lorlatinib toxicity (CNS effects, hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia) given CYP3A4 metabolism; baseline and periodic assessment of glucose and lipid panels recommended. Counsel patient on strict avoidance of CYP3A4 inducers/inhibitors and consistent adherence to dosing instructions.
